prompt_text: What is the best home care agency in Pleasanton CA for an elderly parent?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t enough reliable information to name one agency as *the* best for every family. A good starting shortlist in Pleasanton is:

- **Senior Helpers of Pleasanton** — offers companionship and household help, as well as dementia-related care, live-in and 24-hour care. Call **925-392-7643**. [Website](https://www.seniorhelpers.com/ca/pleasanton/)
- **Right at Home Pleasanton** — provides help with daily activities, personal care, mobility, transportation and support for conditions such as Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s. [Agency listing](https://www.caring.com/senior-care/in-home-care/california/pleasanton)
- **Always Best Care of Pleasanton** — another local option to include in your comparisons. [Agency listing](https://www.caring.com/senior-care/in-home-care/california/pleasanton)

I’d interview at least two agencies before deciding. Ask who supervises care, how caregivers are screened and trained, whether the same caregiver can come regularly, how absences are covered, and what the full hourly minimums and cancellation terms are. Be specific about your parent’s needs—especially dementia experience, transfers, overnight coverage, or medication reminders—and request references.

Before hiring, verify the agency’s current California license and ask for proof of insurance and workers’ compensation coverage. The **Pleasanton Senior Center** may also be able to point you toward local senior-care resources: **925-931-5365**. [City senior services](https://www.cityofpleasantonca.gov/your-community/recreation/senior-services/)
